hero_subtitle: Premium Barbershop Experience • Expert Fades & Styles
about_text:
Yo Robert Davis here! Man when I was 7 years old, Fades were everything! When I saw my older brother and all his friends with those crispy fades it was over for me. When I finally got mines I couldn't stop running my hands through my hair and looking in the mirror everyday!

I couldn't wait to go to school on Monday, so everyone could see my fresh fade. As I got older I started to realize how important and special barbers were, and I knew I wanted to be just like my barber Mr. Flacco when I grew up. I've been cutting hair for over 10 years now and I still love it! If it wasn't for the love of the Fade, I don't know where I'd be! #CUSTOMFADES
